findings.evidence: For an outline: check that the opening names the audience's decision or takeaway, each section carries one point, order follows the audience's need, and the close states the ask.
findings.fix: Cut this to the one check the model tends to miss, for example 'the close states the ask'. Then point to the professional-communication skill that is already preloaded. The model knows generic outline advice.

findings.evidence: From-scratch email: ask the user to run `/command-compose-email:compose-email` if that plugin is installed; otherwise draft it here with the review checklist. Structured feedback: ... Code, legal or compliance review: decline ...
findings.fix: Split the Handoffs paragraph into a short list with one line per case: from-scratch email, feedback delivery, code/legal/compliance. That keeps the ordered Process structure the Intake and Roleplay sections use, instead of three procedures in one sentence.

findings.evidence: ## Gotchas has only two items (deadline softening, Cc/reply-all)
findings.fix: Add gotchas about the channel that defy what people expect. Example: Slack and email notification previews show only the first line, so an ask buried below that line is never seen. Example: 'per my last email' and 'as I said' read as passive-aggressive even with friendly wording. Give each one a reason.

findings.evidence: otherwise draft it here with the review checklist ... build the SBI message from their facts with that skill and review it as a draft
findings.fix: Two parts of the file disagree. Line 14 says 'You coach the user on text they already have', and the description says 'not for writing from scratch'. Line 69 tells the agent to write a draft anyway. Pick one rule. Either (a) when compose-email is missing, give the What-Why-How outline and ask the user to write the draft, or (b) allow a first draft built only from the user's facts and change line 14 and the description to match.

findings.evidence: Route: draft or outline given -> Review ... upcoming conversation, no draft -> Roleplay; unclear -> ask which in one question.
findings.fix: Add a route for a draft plus an upcoming conversation, such as feedback notes for a 1:1. Suggested route: review the draft first, then offer Roleplay on the revised version.
